authority: Author-proposed bindings for Ciardelli2023InquisitivePropositional, read from the actual routed body, annex and rule sheet on 9 September 2026. This proposal does not edit symbol-scopes.json or the canonical registry. Apply the exact row corrections below together with the eight bindings, so local P and f roles are not assigned whole-chapter scope.

P8 inquisitive-propositional.presentation: Common Ciardelli2023 support vocabulary, formula constructors, classical fragment, equivalence, resolution sets and information-state semantics. The atom-set P and resolution-map f are excluded from this broad alias by the row corrections below; proof P and code-table f retain local roles.

P8 inquisitive natural deduction.presentation: Proof P, the extracted algorithm F_P and resolution-transfer maps f in the resolution and deduction treatment. The f introduced in the recursive resolution clause is an arbitrary map between resolution sets; its dependence property is subsequently defined and proved. This alias excludes the finite code table, where f is only a label for one particular question.

P8 inquisitive completeness.presentation: The canonical information model M^c, its world set W^c and valuation V^c, restricted to their definition, support lemma, completeness theorem and the corresponding proofs.

P8 inquisitive expressiveness.presentation: Atom set P in its language/model declarations and finite-profile use; Omega_Q and the characteristic formulas chi_v/chi_A; Dedekind count D(m). The coherence proof uses the same characteristic formulas to construct the InqC exclusion clauses. No proof-tree P is assigned the atom-set role.

P8 inquisitive coherence.presentation: The coherence degree d(phi) and the source InqC polar fragment, in their exact body definitions/theorem and the full coherence proof. This scope ends before the distinct tensor extension.

P8 inquisitive tensor extension.presentation: Tensor disjunction on information states, defined by a union decomposition; its expression/elimination/nondefinability theorem and proof. This is not the linear-logic tensor elsewhere in P8.

P8 inquisitive finite code example.presentation: The nine-code world sets R_i, C_i and A_i, in their defining table and the later code entailment lookup. The named finite-calculations proof reuses R_1/A_1 in its code-table paragraphs; it does not reinterpret R(phi) as a code-world set.

P8 inquisitive finite four-world example.presentation: The valuation blocks P_0/P_1 and Q_0/Q_1 for the specifically declared four-world example and its corresponding portion of the finite-calculations proof. They are not the earlier atom set P or a general model universe.

required_field_corrections.reason: P is explicitly introduced at def:p08-inq-language. The literal L_c is first introduced only inside def:p08-inq-resolutions. One shared first_use value cannot describe both. P is also used locally as a proof name later, so the atom-set row receives the narrower expressiveness/declaration binding.

replacement_rows.notes: The atom set is used in the language, valuation and finite-profile declarations. Proof P has its own local natural-deduction scope.

The literal L_c first appears as the codomain of a resolution selection, where it is explicitly declared to be the classical fragment. Classical means inquisitive-disjunction-free after expanding defined connectives.

proposed_fields.role: map between resolution sets; a dependence function when the stated entailment condition holds
proposed_fields.notes: The recursive implication-resolution clause introduces arbitrary f:R(phi)->R(psi). Its additional semantic dependence condition is defined later at def:p08-inq-logical-dependence. The finite code-table content label f is outside this scope.

required_field_corrections.reason: The first actual f occurs in the implication-resolution clause before the dependence-function definition. Calling every earlier f a dependence function would overstate its role; later proofs also use f as the map selecting a consequent resolution.

The generic persistent support relation is explicitly used and declared in def:p08-inq-general-entailment, including [phi]_M={s:M,s models phi}. The later def:p08-inq-support supplies its concrete recursive InqB clauses; it is not the first appearance of this relation.

standing: Eight exact scope aliases proposed, with three concrete intake corrections. The combined-row split makes 28 rows after application. No shared JSON, canonical CSV, manuscript, rule sheet or driver was edited; no extra content review or build was run.
